title: Celestial Observatory Staircase
description: A woman in a dark flowing robe with white accents stands on a flooded spiral staircase inside a decaying circular observatory. The domed ceiling is covered in cracked, peeling maps of the world while an aurora borealis and dramatic light beams illuminate the starry purple sky above.
